test_description: Per-IC protocol decode for the AD7522LN DAC during a +7 dBm → -5 dBm level sweep. Probes LB, HB, LDAC, and 5 data bits (DB3..DB7). The protocol_decode analyser samples the 5-bit data bus on each LB rising edge, decodes the low-byte value being requested, and reports whether each level change carried the expected code. Use this on AC4 IC6.
